title: Chicken or turkey, breaded, fried, garden salad with bacon and cheese

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of breaded, fried chicken or turkey served with a garden salad that includes bacon, cheese, lettuce, tomatoes, carrots and other vegetables. No dressing is added, allowing control over fat and calorie content.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chicken and turkey are lean sources of protein, while the breading gives a crunchy crust.
Bacon adds a characteristic smoky flavor and increases the dish’s calorie density.
Cheese provides additional calcium and protein.
The lack of dressing makes the meal lighter and lets diners add their own sauce if desired.
Carrots and tomatoes in the salad are rich in vitamins A and C.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: Chicken and turkey contain all essential amino acids, supporting tissue growth and repair.

items.title: B vitamins
items.content: Poultry is high in vitamin B6 and niacin, which aid metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Calcium from cheese
items.content: Cheese adds calcium needed for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Antioxidants in vegetables
items.content: Tomatoes and carrots provide lycopene and beta‑carotene, protecting cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Lettuce and other vegetables supply fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Frying in breading and adding bacon increase saturated fat and calorie levels.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Bacon and cheese can be high in salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Cheese may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to milk proteins.

items.title: Trans fats in breading
items.content: Deep‑frying can create trans fats, which are harmful to cardiovascular health.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish as a main meal. The salad can be dressed lightly with olive oil and lemon juice if desired. Slice the chicken or turkey into strips for easy eating.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the fried chicken or turkey refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 days. Store the salad separately in a sealed container and consume within 24 hours to maintain vegetable freshness.
